sys_script.description: Before-insert and before-update on x_casemgmt_case_task: refuses any write that would store an empty mandatory case/subject/assigned_to/due_date, or a `case` reference that does not resolve to a live x_casemgmt_case row. Closes QA finding F15 for the task table, which carried NO business rule at all - all seven shipped rules are on x_casemgmt_case - so its mandatory and referential constraints existed only at the form layer. Measured before this rule: POST with case=deadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeef returned 201 (dangling mandatory reference) and POST with an empty case returned 201 (parentless task). Enforces AAP Section 0.5.7 (case/subject/assigned_to/due_date Mandatory) and Section 0.5.2 (case references resolve by key). The parent is resolved with plain GlideRecord, not GlideRecordSecure, so the rule tests EXISTENCE only and leaves authorization to the scoped ACLs of Section 0.5.6. Order=100; returns early on current.isActionAborted(); reproduces none of the four verbatim messages Section 0.7.4 fixes. Does not fire on delete, so the cascade rule on the case reference and the manager Delete grant are both untouched. Contains zero gs.eventQueue() calls per the email-disabled constraint.
sys_script.name: x_casemgmt_validate_case_task_integrity
